function armFrame(V, C?): void;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/frame.ts:42

Stores the real Vector3 (+ optional Color) constructors — bootstrap calls this after the lazy three import so frame.ts never imports three itself. The Color pair pre-builds the glaciation tint ramp so the per-frame cycle lerps without allocating.
